title: Ermittlungen der BAO Ferrum: Vollstreckung eines Haftbefehls in Nordrhein-Westfalen und Sicherstellung von Vermögenswerten

extraction.summaryEn: Police arrested a 42-year-old suspect in Hamm (North Rhine-Westphalia) on a warrant from the BAO Ferrum investigation into a group suspected of shootings and extortion of businesses. Assets worth roughly several hundred thousand euros, including vehicles, cash and precious metals, have been secured.
